title: aaj maatam bapa hai waawaila
body:
aaj maatam bapa hai waawaila
diya abid ko sam waleede layee'n
ghul ye harsu bapa hai wawaila
roe chalees saal behre pidar
<<DIVIDER>>
ranj ki intehaa'n hai waawaila
ummate jadd ke baqsh waane ko
zulm sheh ne saha hai wawaila
hai madeene me hashr ka saamaa'n
<<DIVIDER>>
har mohib ro raha hai waawaila
aaj chouthe imaam ka saaya
sab ke sar se utha hai wawaila
qaak udaate hai betiya'n bete
<<DIVIDER>>
sheh ka lasha pada hai wawaila
